headline: Senate votes on AGOA trade extension Monday as both chambers prep for recess sprint!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate rejected motions to proceed on two measures: one on child care fund regulations (47-52) and another on Iran hostilities authorization (49-50). The chamber confirmed dozens of military nominations and began consideration of the AGOA Extension Act, with a cloture vote scheduled for Monday.
